assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit ONLY the printed lid label of Image 1, the small shallow closed SHEFA naturel 125 g tub. Image 2 (tall 500 g tub) is the REFERENCE FOR LID ARTWORK ONLY. Copy its entire printed top lid design accurately onto the small tub's lid: exact black SHEFA lettering with blue logo and red underline, same font/colors of flavor text, same bowl/food artwork and layout, small storage text and label marks. Change the printed weight from 500 gr. to 125 gr. Retain the barcode and certification belonging to Image 1 rather than borrowing a different product barcode. Most important: preserve Image 1 small shallow 125g tub silhouette, proportions, viewpoint, location, clear CLOSED plastic lid, plain colored sides, lighting, white background and canvas composition exactly. Do NOT change the body or put a cow/farm/logo on its side. Do NOT turn the small tub into a tall pot. Only replace the lid printing to match the 500g lid. No dates or batch codes. Output one small closed 125g tub on white, no large pot, no comparison panel.
